verdict.rationale: The evidence describes continuous batching, scheduling, and a benchmarking CLI that can measure serving throughput. None of it states a documented maximum number of concurrent requests or connections, or a point where throughput degrades. The benchmark tool lets a developer measure limits but does not document them, so it is only adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I know the documented maximum concurrent requests or connections the local server can handle before throughput degrades
